system.hook: the squads shield - duty to protect
system.conflict: Intense obligation to Squad, saving them
system.biography: Ranger graduate who stayed with the Platoon for one more deployment out of duty. Stoic and hard. Ham radio enthusiast. Demanding of the squad and attachments. Never without his Catholic cross, feels it’s his duty to protect the squad. Recently deployed to the Philippines, earning a Silver Star and Ranger school. Iraq Veteran.

system.description: Riflemen are the backbone of any military force, the essential soldier whose skills, endurance, and adaptability define the success of a patrol. In Outside the Wire, this archetype represents the foundation of military play as characters who are reliable, versatile, and always in the action’s thick. The Rifleman doesn’t lead from the map or issue orders from the rear; they’re the first in and the last out, shaping the fight through discipline, precision, and raw willpower. Every engagement, from street-to-street combat to jungle ambushes or desert patrols, relies on the Rifleman’s steadiness under fire.

Ranger School is an endurance crucible
that tests leadership, survival, and
small-unit tactics under exhaustion,
hunger, and constant field pressure.
Students cycle through phases, woodland,
mountain, and swamp, executing patrols,
ambushes, raids, and reconnaissance
missions with minimal sleep. Every
action is graded, forcing candidates to
plan, navigate, lead, and fight while
depleted. The course forges adaptable
fighters who thrive in uncertainty and
execute missions even when conditions
collapse. A Ranger-trained character
brings elite field craft, discipline,
and unbreakable willpower to an Outside
the Wire, often anchoring high-risk
operations or steadying less experienced
teammates when everything goes wrong.
Graduates of this school gain Knowledge
+1 and Strength +1. Every Ranger graduate
is offered an opportunity to join SOF.

Air Assault School is an intense, fast-paced program that trains soldiers to insert, maneuver, and operate with helicopters under extreme pressure. Students endure demanding physical conditioning, master aircraft safety and rapid loading/unloading procedures, and learn to rig and inspect sling loads while working beneath hovering helicopters in blinding rotor wash. The school equips a character with expertise in air mobile tactics, fast-rope or LZ operations, sling-load handling, and rapid reaction skills, ideal for missions requiring speed, coordination, and insertion behind enemy lines. Graduates of this school perform air mobile operations and gain Strength +1.
